worlds.name: The Whispering Fields
worlds.subtitle: World 1
worlds.description: Where the film first tore. Wind, straw, and old harvest gods.

worlds.name: Salt & String
worlds.subtitle: World 2
worlds.description: A drowned docktown where reels rust in the tide pools.

worlds.name: The Rotten Orchard
worlds.subtitle: World 3
worlds.description: Apple trees that fruit in ink. The cider press never stops.

worlds.name: Clockworks County
worlds.subtitle: World 4
worlds.description: Gear towns that run the projector on steam. Everything ticks.

worlds.name: The Hollow Opera
worlds.subtitle: World 5
worlds.description: An opera house that plays itself, audience of shadows.

worlds.name: Studio Zero
worlds.subtitle: Final World
worlds.description: The projection room at the end of the reel.
